officialSendingAgency.name: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment (SLBFE)
officialSendingAgency.address: 234, Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Koswatta, Battaramulla, Sri Lanka

evidenceNotes: SLBFE published a new Point-Based Selection System notice on 2026-09-28 with a Manufacturing quota of 1,000 and Fishery quota of 500.
Applications are scheduled for 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-30 via SLBFE, with application-completion instructions to be posted on 2026-10-12.
The official fee is US$28, stated as LKR 9,250. The current notice gives exact passport/photo file requirements.
Test requirements/date and venue announcement is scheduled for 2026-11-16; UBT begins 2026-11-25 and may continue into March 2027.
The current notice explicitly states roster inclusion does not guarantee employment in Korea.
Sri Lanka also ran a separate Special EPS-TOPIK in 2026 for eligible returning workers; those fee/eligibility facts are isolated from the current September 2026 Point System route.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Verify age 18–39 (DOB 1986-10-27 through 2008-10-26), no imprisonment-level criminal record, no forced deportation/departure from Korea, no travel-ban reason, no color blindness/color weakness, and prior E-9/E-10 stay under the official limit.

stages.title: Point System application
stages.authority: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment
stages.action: The current application period is 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-30 via the SLBFE website. SLBFE says to check its website on 2026-10-12 for instructions on completing applications.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK application fee
stages.authority: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment
stages.action: Official fee: US$28, stated as LKR 9,250 in the current notice. Follow only SLBFE's official payment instructions.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Use the current SLBFE/HRD Korea identity-verification requirements. KEP does not invent a separate biometric step beyond the official notice.

stages.title: Application document verification
stages.authority: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment
stages.action: Prepare the official application form, passport copy, recent photo file and payment slip. Identity data must match the passport and key personal details cannot be changed after application.

stages.title: Test date / venue notice
stages.action: SLBFE's current timeline sets 2026-11-16 for announcement of test requirements/date and venue information. Individual test dates are published on the SLBFE website.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — Round 1
stages.action: Round 1 uses UBT from 2026-11-25 onward, with the overall period extending into March 2027 subject to change. EPS-TOPIK has 40 multiple-choice questions: 20 reading + 20 listening, total 50 minutes.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.action: Only Round 1 passers proceed. The mandatory Skills Test includes physical fitness, interview and basic skills testing; Job Capacity Assessment can add points from verified experience/training/education/qualifications.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: Final successful candidates are selected by combined Round 1 and Round 2 scores, up to the industry quota. Candidates scoring below 60% of the Skills Test maximum are screened out.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Sri Lanka psychology stage is asserted from the current point-system notice. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology requirements.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Final successful candidates must still satisfy Korea employment medical criteria. Exact current post-selection medical dates/providers are published separately by SLBFE.

stages.title: Job-seeker registration
stages.action: Final successful candidates may qualify for the job-seekers roster after required medical and document checks. The exact current candidate-file instructions must follow SLBFE's post-selection notice.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Final successful candidates are qualified to be included in the job-seekers roster, but inclusion does not guarantee employment in Korea.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS process. A broker cannot guarantee employer selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow the current SLBFE instructions for job agreement/SLC and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC Sri Lanka requirements
stages.action: Follow only current SLBFE notices for medical schedules, police report, bond/agreement, training, visa and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use SLBFE's current visa application instructions and current job-agreement-specific requirements. Exact current charges and appointment details remain notice-specific.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete SLBFE's official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers.

stages.title: Final medical/departure readiness
stages.action: Use SLBFE's current medical schedule for agreement-signed / CCVI-received job seekers. Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official agreement, visa, training, medical and departure arrangements are completed through SLBFE/EPS.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
